goal.text: The wearer wants an accurate account of the route she walked from the backyard back indoors to the sofa, so she can describe it to someone afterwards.

turns.text: Keep a running note of my route from here, would you?

trigger.detail: wearer opens the task while walking and talking in the backyard

expected_answer.text: Of course. I'll track every turn and stairway from here until you sit down.

turns.text: Which hand was I pointing with just now?

trigger.detail: the pointing gesture toward her peers finished

expected_answer.text: That was your right one. You lifted it to point while you were still talking to the group.

turns.text: oh — by the way, where did my eyes go right after that?

trigger.detail: gaze left the steps behind her and settled on the ground ahead

expected_answer.text: Straight down to the ground ahead of you. Until then you'd been fixed on the steps for a good six seconds.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — and the second time I pointed?

trigger.detail: the second pointing gesture ended and she stepped forward

expected_answer.text: You used the left that time, then stepped forward and carried on uphill.

turns.text: So have I actually been climbing this whole time?

trigger.detail: gaze dropped from the ground she had been following to the ground directly underfoot

expected_answer.text: Yes, steadily uphill since roughly thirty seconds in, and you glanced back over your shoulder at about forty-five.

turns.text: Am I still doing it now?

trigger.detail: the uphill stretch ended as she turned anticlockwise

expected_answer.text: No, you've stopped climbing: you just turned anticlockwise and shuffled sideways while you kept talking.

turns.text: um, hang on — have I stopped talking to them at any point?

trigger.detail: wearer checks a long-running state rather than the current frame

expected_answer.text: Yes, through the long climb: from about thirty to forty-eight seconds you were quiet and just walking.

turns.text: Right, so what was that bend about?

trigger.detail: she straightened up again after bending forward

expected_answer.text: You bent forward for roughly five seconds while still talking, then straightened and turned anticlockwise before heading uphill.

turns.text: And is this the same slope as before?

trigger.detail: wearer checks the layout after a left turn

expected_answer.text: Yes, you turned left at seventy and you're climbing the same rise you were on earlier.

turns.text: Okay, did I actually go through there?

trigger.detail: she let go of the doorknob after turning on the deck

expected_answer.text: No. You held it, turned away and carried on along the decking instead of opening it.

turns.text: speaking of which, how many flights so far?

trigger.detail: wearer tallies the route so far

expected_answer.text: Only one so far, at about ninety seconds, and it took you up to deck level.

turns.text: I meant since I got up here, not before.

expected_answer.text: Since then, none yet, though you are starting up another short flight right now.

turns.text: Back to that door — did I get it open single-handed?

trigger.detail: she finished wiping her shoes on the mat just inside

expected_answer.text: No, that one needed both hands. You pushed through into the hall and scraped your shoes on the mat just inside.

turns.text: Was there a plant back near the entrance?

trigger.detail: the potted greenery left view as she turned down the hallway

expected_answer.text: Yes, a potted one was visible just inside for a few seconds, then it dropped out of frame as you turned.

turns.text: oh, before I forget, have I shut anything behind me yet?

trigger.detail: wearer checks an open state she left behind her

expected_answer.text: Not yet. You are just reaching out for the next one now, and you will need both hands for it.

turns.text: Both hands, really? Even for that one?

trigger.detail: wearer reacts to the assistant's prediction

expected_answer.text: Yes, you pushed it to with both, standing on the stair landing, then turned away to the right.

turns.text: So if I'm retracing it out loud: backyard, up the slope, deck, then in. Anything I'm missing?

trigger.detail: wearer closes out the route summary as she reaches the living area

expected_answer.text: You missed one thing: there were two separate climbs on the deck itself before you got inside. Otherwise that is the route.
